name: Modtest Demo (deep-mod proof)

sections.title: Grip becomes a cyber-hound
sections.description: Patches a core monster's name, colour and hit points.

sections.title: Add the Modberry Slime
sections.description: Adds a brand new monster, from a `late` section so the band path is exercised too.

compat.because: Both demos are about visible change; this one should be the one you see.

author: neostryder
description: A bundled demo content pack that proves mods reach the running game: it patches a core monster and adds a new one. Both are named SECTIONS, so it also proves a player can take half a mod, and that a section can add records as well as patch them. Disabled by default; enable with ?mods=demo-modtest.
